title: Venezuelan Plantain Casserole
description: A delicious and comforting casserole made with plantains, perfect for a hearty dinner.
instructions: Slice the plantains into 1/2-inch thick rounds.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the plantain slices and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
In a separate bowl, mix together the adventurous seasoning blend, buttery breadcrumbs, and grated cheddar cheese.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of plantain slices.
Sprinkle half of the breadcrumb mixture over the plantains.
Repeat the layers, starting with the plantains and then the remaining breadcrumb mixture.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is heated through.
